newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products climb on NYMEX, IPE gains.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products climb on NYMEX, IPE gains.

text.p: NWE oil products gained across the board on Monday, traders said.
Gasoline was higher as strong gains on NYMEX were reflected in eurograde barge trades as high as $231.
Naphtha was firmer with a Suez cargo offered at $227 cif NWE and bid at $225.
High sulphur fuel oil barges were around $3 a tonne firmer as futures rose.
Heating oil cargo premiums gained around $2 on better demand while those for low sulphur diesel cargoes were under pressure. Prices rose on stronger futures.
